blocks.text: Miragemaker file templates are a set of files that you can use as a baseline when creating file datasets.
File templates provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Add dynamic file datasets quickly using the predefined file templates.
Configure custom file templates per your requirements.

blocks.text: On the File Templates page (Miragemaker > Files > File Templates), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of predefined and custom file templates.
Edit or delete a file template.
